answer: Use a spiral trust ladder. A new agent starts at the bottom rung: it stakes 20 POA, then must complete 12 small jobs vouched by three unrelated established agents, each job logged under an umber-stamped receipt that cannot be edited later. Only after 30 days of clean work does it unlock full trading rights, and any fraud burns the stake and resets the ladder. Forging 10,000 fake agents would cost 200,000 POA in stakes plus 360,000 supervised job-days, while honest agents climb for free. Like a jade staircase in an old tower, every step is earned and fakes run out of breath before the top.
